patterns.vague_location: Location is unclear ('here', 'the hallway') - interview: most common missing item
patterns.missing_sheet: No sheet or detail number given
patterns.wrong_or_incomplete_sheet: Sheet number incomplete or ambiguous (e.g., 'A2', '5/A-50') - interview: 2-3 in 10 RFIs
patterns.outdated_reference: Cites a detail that a later revision replaced - interview: subs keep using the bid set
patterns.missing_deadline: No needed-by date, or only 'ASAP' - interview: 'if everything is ASAP, nothing is ASAP'
patterns.missing_impact: Does not say what work is held up or what it costs
patterns.multi_question: Several questions in one message - interview: GC has to split them
patterns.photo_without_description: Says 'see pic' without saying what the photo shows
patterns.scope_cost_hint: Wording hints at extra cost / scope ('hiding money') - interview: GC checks contract with PM
